blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving with no prior experience needed. They freefall for 40 seconds at 120 mph and then float under parachute back to the landing area beside the runway. The dropzone is located in Pahokee on the shore of Lake Okeechobee, about an hour from West Palm Beach.
extraNote: Free to reschedule with 24 hours notice · Palm Beach County Glades Airport, landing beside the runway
